title: Italian Stir-Fry Delight
description: A quick and easy stir-fry dish that combines the flavors of Italy with the simplicity of a stir-fry.
instructions: Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked sausage back into the pan and stir to combine with the onion and bell peppers.
Add the Italian seasoning and stir-fry sauce to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over cooked rice and garnish with chopped fresh basil.
